column3: Two checks added by this PR precede UpdateSecret: requireActorActive (#4159) reads only the actor's own account row; requireOwnerHoldsGatePermission (#4160) reads the secret row and the actor's roles, but reuses the row checkSecretPermission already read, so it adds no window beyond the one main already had between EnforceSecret*Permission and the write. A stale pass equals update-then-suspend or update-then-owner-demoted, both legal serial orders; both checks only narrow what the function allowed before.
